catalog_quirks.body: OpenRouter’s :free daily cap (50/day, or 1000/day once you have ever bought $10 of credits) is shared across ALL :free models on the account, not per model. Per-row rpd values here are therefore optimistic; the router’s cooldown handling absorbs the shared 429s.
catalog_quirks.title: Daily :free cap is account-wide

catalog_quirks.body: Some free routes spend hidden reasoning tokens before visible output. Avoid tiny max_tokens values or requests can finish by length with empty content.
catalog_quirks.title: Needs token room

catalog_quirks.body: nemotron-3-ultra (550B) on OpenRouter takes 180s+ even on trivial prompts (heavily congested), so its OR row is seeded disabled. Use the OpenCode Zen route instead.

catalog_quirks.body: Key-tested on September 21, 2026. OpenRouter answers deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free with "This model is unavailable for free. description: OpenAI-compatible aggregator exposing hundreds of models under one API; includes :free variants with account-wide daily caps (50 requests/day, or 1000 after a lifetime purchase of at least 10 credits) and 20 RPM. Paid usage is billed per token at upstream provider prices plus a 5.5% fee on credit purchases.
name: OpenRouter
setup_instructions:
1. Create an account at https://openrouter.ai (no card required for free models).
2. Add credits at https://openrouter.ai/settings/credits if you want paid models or the higher 1000/day free-model cap.
3. Create an API key at https://openrouter.ai/keys.
4. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY and point an OpenAI-compatible client at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
